executive_summary.text: Cost year 2024: direct care cost was $172.3 per resident day (43.7% of expenses); Connecticut median $169.07.
Cost year 2024: nursing home operating margin was -6.1% (Connecticut median 0.5%).
Cost year 2024: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $670,901, 8.2% of the $8,204,584 direct care cost.

Cost year 2024: dietary cost $1,308,903, $27.49 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.6). Wages $624,828 (47.7%), allocated fringe $157,508 (12.0%), non-wage costs $526,567 (40.2%). Raw food was $479,558 ($10.07 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.59).
Cost year 2024: housekeeping cost $575,655, $12.09 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.07). Wages $416,634 (72.4%), allocated fringe $105,026 (18.2%), non-wage costs $53,995 (9.4%).
Cost year 2024: laundry cost $261,661, $5.49 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.41). Wages $179,857 (68.7%), allocated fringe $45,339 (17.3%), non-wage costs $36,465 (13.9%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; costs per resident day outside the plausible range; revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; payer days do not add up to the printed total; revenue lines do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2016 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; balance sheet does not add up). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
